gloss: to mix together; to blend; to combine

definitions.gloss: to mix together; to blend; to combine
definitions.explanation: To stir or fold two or more substances together so they form a single uniform mixture. The {合|あ}わせる element stresses bringing the parts together into one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる。
⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: I blended two colors of paint together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Blend the eggs and sugar well, then add the flour.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧ (to mix) + ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to put together). Common in cooking and craft instructions for combining multiple ingredients into one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる: to combine the ingredients
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる: to mix thoroughly
- ⟦{均一|きんいつ}→均一：12049_kinitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる: to blend evenly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix — simpler; {混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる emphasizes blending several things into one uniform whole
